neighbours.label: the 'b' piece that follows a split ' Al' in a Romance or Latin name (Al|bi, Al|bus, Al|ba, Al|by)
fire: The red brick cathedral of Albi dominates the old quarter.
In the garden she grew Lupinus Albus beside the beans.
Every autumn the truffle fair in Alba draws large crowds.
The ferry stopped briefly at the island of Alborán.
The rice fields around the Albufera lagoon flood each spring.
The small Swedish town of Alby has one main street.
The fishermen sold their catch at the market in Albas.
A train from Toulouse to Albi takes about one hour.
quiet: The red brick cathedral of Albany dominates the old quarter.
In the garden she grew beans beside the roses.
Every autumn the fair in Albacete draws large crowds.
The ferry stopped briefly at the coast of Albania.
The rice fields around the old village flood each spring.
The singer Alberto has one famous song.
The fishermen sold their catch at the market in Albion.
A train from Denver to Albuquerque takes many hours.

predictions: 6/8 fire above 0.3; Al- names that are whole tokens or split as Alb|/Albert| stay below 0.15.
